subject: Q3 Expansion forecast: HearthCare upgrade readiness & action checklist
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Expansion forecast: HearthCare upgrade readiness & action checklist

Hi team,

Quick ask: finance needs a short hygiene pass on the HearthCare upsell before the commit review on Thursday. Current forecast shows $240k ARR upside for Q3 but the opportunity is still marked "Negotiation" in HubSpot and I want to validate the key signals before we include it in next week's rollup.

Can each of you confirm the following by end of day Wednesday?
- Current expected close date (HubSpot deal date) and whether procurement is engaged.
- Who is the internal champion and whether exec sponsor is confirmed.
- Any open legal/security docs outstanding (SOC2, DPA, export controls).
- Deployment readiness: planned go-live window and CS resource needs (hand-off tasks).

I've attached a short checklist and our latest proposal for reference: HearthCare_upside_checklist.xlsx (summary rows) and Proposal_v2.pdf. Also pulled a SOC2 extract that procurement asked for earlier.

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/3478 (deal RDW-2027-0473)

Goal: get this into "Commit" for finance if the signals check out, otherwise move to "On Deck" with a clear gating plan.

Thanks — Marcus

Marcus Lin
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
[Attachment: HearthCare_upside_checklist.xlsx]
[Attachment: Proposal_v2.pdf]
[Attachment: SOC2-extract.pdf]

From: Samir Patel <samir@hearthcare.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@hearthcare.com>, procurement@hearthcare.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Expansion forecast: HearthCare upgrade readiness & action checklist

Hi Marcus — thanks for the checklist. Quick updates from our side:

- Expected close date: 2027-07-20 (we're targeting end of July to align with our fiscal planning).
- Procurement: engaged; procurement@hearthcare.com is reviewing the proposal and will respond with contract comments by 06/22.
- Champion / Sponsor: Primary champion is Laura Chen (Head of Ops). Executive sponsor is Ben Rosario (VP Product), verbal confirmation in last week's call.
- Security: SOC2 extract looks fine; procurement asked for a short runbook on data retention — I attached the procurement contact's note.
- Deployment: we aim to start pilot in the first two weeks of Aug; CS involvement will be required for onboarding (two workshops + integration support).

I'll loop in procurement for redlines and keep you posted.

Samir
Samir Patel
Director of Engineering | HearthCare
samir@hearthcare.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@hearthcare.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Expansion forecast: HearthCare upgrade readiness & action checklist

Thanks Samir — good clarity. From CS readiness perspective: 

- Stage update: moving to "Procurement" stage in HubSpot; I will update the close probability to 60% based on procurement engaged + exec sponsor.
- Champion / Sponsor: confirmed Laura as champion; I've asked for a 30-min alignment call with Ben to confirm sponsorship scope.
- Onboarding plan: proposed two workshops (Architectural kickoff + API integration session) and a 10-day pilot window. CS estimated resource allocation: 0.25 FTE for 6 weeks (onboarding + handover).
- Risks / blockers: procurement's request for the retention runbook is a gating item for legal sign-off; also awaiting details on SSO provider (Okta vs Azure AD).

Action items: 
1) Samir — can procurement send the redline timeline (you said 06/22) and confirm if the runbook template is sufficient.
2) Evelyn — please prepare a short onboarding scope (1-pager) and a rough timeline so Finance can mark the revenue recognition window.
3) Marcus / Karthik — please confirm whether we want to treat this as "Commit" for Thursday's finance rollup or hold in "On Deck" until the runbook and SS0 details are cleared.

I updated the deal record with the latest notes and attached the CS onboarding sketch to the deal.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
[Attachment: CS_onboarding_sketch.pdf]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@hearthcare.com>, procurement@hearthcare.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Expansion forecast: HearthCare upgrade readiness & action checklist

Great — thanks everyone for the quick turn. Final coordination notes before Thursday's commit review: 

- Decision: move HearthCare to "Commit" for finance rollup on 2027-06-24 at 10:00am PT conditional on procurement submitting initial redlines by 2027-06-22 and confirmation of SSO provider. If either item is missing, we'll keep the deal in "On Deck" and include a clear gating row in the rollup.
- Evelyn: please translate the CS timeline into a revenue recognition window (start of pilot -> go-live) and flag any timing variance >30 days.
- Monica: please schedule the 15-min sponsor alignment with Ben and Laura this week (opt: 06/18 or 06/21).
- Karthik: FYI from a product-compatibility lens — can you confirm the SDK compatibility matrix by EOD Monday so onboarding can lock in integration steps.

I'll update the HubSpot deal with the conditional commit language (deal RDW-2027-0473). Samir — appreciate procurement keeping us to the 06/22 cadence. If there's any blocker on the runbook template, flag me directly and I'll escalate to Legal.

Thanks — Marcus

Marcus Lin
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
